purpose: Records decisions to keep the inherited-SKILL responsibility declaration norm and to declare uv exclude-newer in metadata rather than command options, with context, rationale and rejected alternatives.
summary: ADR collecting decisions for the common area
Decision 1: keep the responsibility declaration norm at the top of inherited-type SKILLs even though no problem currently occurs
Rationale: inherited SKILLs lack fork-boundary isolation, so the declaration is the substitute defense against taking over the parent conversation's other work
Scope of the declaration norm covers all inherited SKILLs, not only those invoked from other SKILLs
Rejected for decision 1: deleting the norm because no problem occurs; limiting scope to SKILLs invoked by other SKILLs
Decision 2: declare uv exclude-newer in PEP 723 script metadata or pyproject.toml [tool.uv], not as command options
Rationale: metadata declaration keeps lock and uv run --locked consistent without flags; exclude-newer-package also works
Rejected for decision 2: passing --exclude-newer to uv add/lock, which makes uv run --locked fail with lockfile needs to be updated
Experimental findings are verified only on uv 0.13.5 on macOS
Each decision has context, decision, alternatives considered and impact sections
tasks: Writing or reviewing SKILL.md for inherited-type skills
Deciding whether to delete or relax the responsibility declaration norm
Proposing to fork-type SKILL adoption or isolation changes
Configuring uv exclude-newer for scripts or pyproject.toml
Writing PEP 723 script metadata with tool.uv settings
Updating uv lockfiles or running uv run --locked
Reviewing proposals that cite ADR-089 as rejection basis
title: ADR-089 common の決定記録
